title: Identification of strict quotient-system tensor presentations
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $t=\varpi_E$, and put $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For each scheme $W$ use a fixed small representative of $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathscr S_W$ consist of $(A_n)_W$-module sheaves $M_n$ and $(A_{n+1})_W$-linear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{n+1,n}M_n$, with componentwise morphisms commuting with transitions. Use its ordinary unbounded derived category and simultaneous operations $P_u=u^*$, $R_u=Ru_*$, $P_u\dashv R_u$ with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$, and exact open extension $j_!$ [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Also realize systems as modules over $B_\bullet(n,U)=(A_{n+1})_W(U)$ on the vertical sequence site, indexed by $n\ge0$, with the representative-normalized operations and arrows of [def-pur-system-tensor-mate-arrows]. Let $\mathcal D_W$ denote this latter ordinary unbounded derived category. The reindexing comparison $C_W:D(\mathscr S_W)\simeq\mathcal D_W$, sending level $n\ge1$ to sequence index $n-1$ and leaving sections and transitions unchanged, has canonical operation comparisons
$$C_XP_u\cong P_u^{\rm diag}C_Y,\quad C_YR_u\cong R_u^{\rm diag}C_X,\quad C_Yj_!\cong j_!^{\rm diag}C_X,\quad C_W(M\otimes^LN)\cong C_WM\otimes^L C_WN.$$
These comparisons identify the specified adjunction units and counits, the open units, and the canonical pullback-composition maps. They identify the pullback tensor comparison $\mu_u:P_u(M\otimes^LN)\cong P_uM\otimes^LP_uN$ with the representative-normalized diagram comparison. For arbitrary $H\in D(\mathscr S_X)$ and $Q\in D(\mathscr S_Y)$, they carry the projection arrow $\pi_{u;H,Q}$, defined as the $P_u\dashv R_u$ transpose of $(\varepsilon_{u,H}\otimes1)\mu_u$, to the diagram projection arrow [def-exchange-projection]. For an open $j:X\hookrightarrow Y$, they carry the canonical $\delta_{j;H,Q}:j_!H\otimes^LQ\cong j_!(H\otimes^LP_jQ)$ to the diagram open tensor arrow: its inverse is the open-adjunction transpose of the open unit tensored with $1$ under the pullback tensor comparison [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. In particular the tensor and projection factors in the system clause of [lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate] become precisely these $\mu,\pi,\delta$, with the canonical pullback compositors. All comparisons are on the unbounded derived system categories before evaluation; no cartesianness of systems, coefficient flatness, or boundedness of inputs is assumed.

proof.text: Realize the supplied semilinear source calculus as normalized diagram operations o. Independently obtain a normalized core comparison from o to the given d.

Expand projection as its proper-adjunction transpose. Naturality of the target unit moves the tensor comparison across the unit. Substitute the proper unit equation. Naturality of the pullback comparison, mu compatibility, tensor naturality, and the counit equation identify the remaining arrow inside direct image. Functoriality gives the full projection equation.

Apply the source open Hom bijection. Its transpose after the open-extension comparison is identified with the target transpose using the open unit equation and pullback naturality. Rewrite inverse mu using mu compatibility and naturality. Tensor naturality and the same open unit equation identify the two words. Injectivity proves delta_inverse. Cancel the target deltaInv and use its inverse identities to prove the forward delta equation. Assemble the full comparison, then pair it with the semilinear realization.
The separate explicit ULift realization theorem properOpenFactors is unchanged and remains unproved; its proof is the original universe-transport argument from Steps 1--9.
